fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C)
fees.validity: up to 90 days within any 180-day period
fees.applies: all nationalities requiring a Schengen visa (adults)
fees.notes: Uniform Schengen visa fee, applies to Slovenia as a Schengen member state. Confirmed on Slovenia's official government portal (gov.si) as well.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - child 6-12
fees.validity: up to 90 days within any 180-day period
fees.notes: Children under 6 are exempt from the fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.applies: nationals of countries requiring airport transit visa
fees.notes: Official source confirms airport transit visas exist and are exempt from prior consultation requirements, but does not publish a distinct fee; in practice the standard EUR 90 Schengen visa fee schedule applies to transit visas issued under the common Schengen rules. Left null pending a source that states the transit-specific figure explicitly.

reciprocity_variations.note: Reduced Schengen visa fee under EU visa facilitation agreements, per European Commission Migration and Home Affairs and gov.si.
Reduced Schengen visa fee under EU-Cabo Verde visa facilitation agreement.

vfs.service_fee: ~90-110 (varies by country, e.g. approx USD 105 in the USA)
vfs.currency: local currency of centre (e.g. USD in USA)
vfs.note: VFS Global operates outsourced visa application centres for Slovenia in many countries. Service fee is charged in addition to the EUR 90 official visa fee and varies by country/centre; could not confirm an authoritative published figure via a directly-fetchable official VFS page (visa.vfsglobal.com returned 403 to automated fetch), so this figure is drawn from a secondary aggregator summarizing VFS USA pricing and should be treated as indicative only.
